name: Kepler K2 Bumblebee
summary: K2 Bumblebee is a 175 cm, 75 kg industrial humanoid with 52 DoF and 11-DoF hands. Kepler showed it at ICRA 2025 with a $30,000 base price and claims up to 8 hours of runtime. It targets factory material handling.

payload_kg.original: 15 kg per arm; 30 kg with both arms

runtime_h.original: Up to 8 hours on single one-hour charge

hands: 11-DoF dexterous hands with 25 force-sensing points per finger and a 6-axis wrist force/torque sensor.
highlights: Kepler says over 80% of core hardware is made in-house.
Kepler reported confirmed orders above $6.9 million, per BigGo Finance (May 2026).
caveats: In May 2026 Hangzhou Kelin bought a 51% stake in Kepler at a lower valuation; 2025 revenue was about $638K.
Runtime and payload are company claims.

sources.title: Kepler Robotics showcases K2 Bumblebee humanoid at ICRA 2025
Kepler Robot Sells to Hangzhou Kelin at approximately $106 Million Valuation
